title: A bath: the tap fills it, the plug drains it
checked: Every reachable state checked (3 states, 5 with their data, 9 steps). All 4 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 3 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.
The plug cannot drain water that is not there.
rules.path: Take away the at the overflow guard and it breaks in 3 steps: turn the tap, pull the plug, pull the plug.

rules.says: What the tap adds past 160 L runs out of the overflow. The floor stays dry.
Empty means 0 L, full means up to the overflow, partly full means in between.
rules.path: Take away the bath is empty guard and it breaks in 1 step: turn the tap.
